shortBulletSummary: The Federal Reserve's policy meeting on October 27-28 is expected to result in a rate hold, but any hawkish remarks could pressure crypto.
Bitcoin is struggling around $80,000-$82,000, impacted by institutional ETF outflows and a general risk-off sentiment.
The Crypto Fear & Greed Index remains "Neutral" (45-55), though some analysts warn of a strengthening bearish outlook.
Ethereum's Glamsterdam upgrade, aiming to boost network capacity, is slated for its Hoodi testnet on October 26.
Surging oil prices ($112-$116 per barrel) due to Middle East supply risks are adding pressure to broader risk assets, including cryptocurrencies.
